Every word on screen, right on cue.

Disciples PreCenter is free presentation software for worship services. Songs, Bible passages, announcements, timers and media live in one place, with separate screens for your congregation and your stage.

From planning to presenting

The screenshots below come from the app itself.

Run the whole service from one window

Arrange your playlist into sections, click a slide to send it live, and always see what's up next. Clear text, media or everything with one button.

Turn a passage into slides

Type a reference such as John 3:16-18, or pick the book, chapter and verses. Choose how many verses go on a slide, and add a second version beside the first.

Connect phones and your livestream

With the desktop app, control slides from a phone on the same Wi-Fi by scanning a QR code, or add the audience screen or a lyrics overlay to OBS.

Many screens and your livestream

Send the right picture to the congregation, the stage and your stream.

Multiple output screens

Add several audience and stage screens and choose a display for each. Mirror them, give them different looks or backgrounds, or send one slide to just one screen.

Arrange grids with edge blending, apply masks, or place several outputs on one display.

Windows app

Connects to OBS

Add PreCenter to OBS as a browser source over your local network. Send the full audience screen, or only lyrics and Bible text on a transparent background.

Adjust the overlay's position, font, outline, shadow and box.

Windows app

NDI output

Send your audience or stage screens over the network as NDI sources, for OBS, vMix and other software that receives NDI. No video cable needed.

Each screen set to NDI becomes its own source. NDI audio is not sent.

Disciples: Harmony

Private team app. Not yet available for public use.

Harmony is the worship team's companion to PreCenter. The team prepares songs and Sunday's lineup on their phones, and the operator brings that lineup into the service.

Harmony still needs funds to be published and to get a larger database that can serve a large community.

See all Harmony features
  • Song library with keys and chordsMusicians keep their songs close at hand.
  • Sunday lineupPlan the set and share it with the team.
  • Stage modeA full-screen view for playing live, with adjustable scrolling.
  • PDF and Word exportPrepare song sheets to print or share.
  • Connected to PreCenterSync lineup changes and use a phone as a remote.

A Sunday in three steps

  1. 1. Build

    Create a playlist, add songs, Scripture and the sermon, and drag them into order.

  2. 2. Check

    Set which monitor shows the audience and stage screens, then step through the slides with your team.

  3. 3. Present

    Press Space or the arrow keys to move through the service. Number keys jump to a song section.

Why churches can start today

Free and open source

No subscription. The code is published under the GPL-3.0 licence.

No account needed

Start as a guest. Sign in with Google only if you want your songs backed up and synced.

Your songs stay yours

They are saved on your computer. Online backups are visible only to your account, not to other users.

About the project

PreCenter is part of the Disciples family of worship tools. It was made to ease the work of presenting church services, so worship teams can run a service smoothly.

It is developed in the open. You can read the code, report a problem or suggest a feature on GitHub.

I’m a sole developer, using my God-given gift to bring the best harmony I can for our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. Harmony is limited to my church for now, and we have used it for months. To help bring these applications to a larger community, email me.

Email disciplesworshipp@gmail.comView on GitHubRelease notes

Good to know before Sunday

Is it really free?

Yes. There is no paid version or subscription.

Can I use Harmony?

Not at the moment. Harmony is a private app for our own team. PreCenter works without it.

Does PreCenter work with OBS and NDI?

Yes. In the Windows app, add PreCenter to OBS with a browser source link, or set a screen to NDI output. NDI needs NDI software on your network, and OBS needs an NDI plugin to receive it.

Do I need an account?

No. Guest mode works without one. Google sign-in adds private song backup and sync. Some team features need an invited Disciples team account.

Does it work without internet?

Your work is saved on your device, and the Windows app carries a built-in copy for when the online page can't be reached. Sync and online services need a connection. Test your setup offline before relying on it.

Who can see my songs?

If you are signed in, your songs are backed up online and other users cannot see them. The people running the service have technical access, as explained in the Privacy Policy.

Can I show any song's lyrics?

Many lyrics are protected by copyright. Use songs that are public domain or that your church has permission or a licence to use.

Windows warns about an unknown publisher. Why?

An installer that isn't code-signed triggers this warning. Download only from the official releases page, then choose More info and Run anyway.

    Everything a worship team prepares

    Built for the people who play, sing and lead, not only the people who run the screens.

    Songs and chords

    Chords and lyrics
    Read a song with chords above the words, or switch to lyrics only.
    Transpose
    Move a song to any key, and choose sharp or flat spelling for each note.
    Key detection
    Harmony works out a song’s key from its chords, using the chords of all 24 keys.
    Song flow
    Arrange sections, repeat the chorus, and leave notes for the music director.
    Import
    Paste text or search Ultimate Guitar and bring a song into your library.
    PDF and Word export
    Print song sheets or share them with people who don’t use the app.

    Playing live

    Stage mode
    Big chords and lyrics on black, with the next song in view and the screen kept awake.
    Auto scroll
    Let the song move at a speed you choose. Harmony remembers it for each song.
    Metronome
    Practise with time signatures, subdivisions and a spoken count-in that names each section.
    Key Bridge
    Pick two keys and see ways to move from one song into the next. It also shows between songs in the lineup.
    Your own markings
    Draw on a song. Your notes stay on your phone and never change the team’s copy.

    Team and Sunday

    Teams
    Create a team or join one with an invite code. Each team keeps its own library and lineups.
    Sunday lineup
    Plan each date with a rehearsal time and a service time. Songs show their key and tempo.
    Daily Bible verse
    A verse on the home screen each day.
    Share by link
    Send a read-only copy of the lineup to anyone. Stop sharing whenever you like.
    Team alerts
    A bell shows new songs, lineup updates and key changes. Phones can notify you of new songs.
    Community songs
    Publish a song to a shared shelf, or copy one into your own library.
    Sign in and sync
    Your library and lineups follow you to any phone you sign in on.

    Key Bridge: a smooth way into the next song

    Moving from one song’s key to the next? Pick both keys and Harmony shows the chords of each key and a few ways to get there, instead of jumping straight in.

    Every chord in Harmony comes from one chord set covering all 24 keys. That is how Harmony detects a song’s key, and how Key Bridge knows which chords two keys share.

    A working sample of Harmony’s Key Bridge page.

    Harmony and PreCenter, one team

    Harmony lives on the musicians’ phones. PreCenter lives on the computer that runs the screens. Sign in to the same Disciples team and the two find each other.

    Phones

    Harmony

    • Song library with keys and chords
    • Sunday lineup with keys and tempo
    • Stage mode for playing live
    • Live follow: the song scrolls to the line PreCenter is on
    • Phone remote with Flow, Slide, Bible and Stage tabs
    Phones to computerThe latest lineup with each song’s key and tempo, and taps on the remote: next slide, a Bible passage, clear.
    Computer to phonesWhat’s live now, which line is being sung, what’s next, the chords, and a preview of the audience screen.
    Computer

    PreCenter

    • The latest Harmony lineup on the home screen
    • Open it as a new service, or add its songs to the current one
    • Sync changes when the lineup changes
    • Chords on the stage screen, lyrics only for the congregation
    Over the internet

    Paired by your team

    Everyone signed in to the same Disciples team is paired automatically. Open PreCenter on the computer, turn on Remote, and the phones can follow along.

    Scan the QR code PreCenter shows and the phone connects straight to the computer. Video backgrounds play in this mode.

    What changes for the team and the church

    A service runs smoothly when the people behind it share one plan. Harmony gives them that plan, and PreCenter carries it onto the screens.

    Musicians

    Same song, same key, same arrangement. No more asking the group chat which version Sunday is using.

    Music director

    Plan the lineup once, leave notes on the flow, and watch changes reach everyone on the team.

    Tech operator

    Opens the same lineup the band rehearsed, sees when it changes, and can move slides from a phone.

    The congregation

    Lyrics on the screen match what the team practised, songs flow into each other, and anyone can open the lineup link to see what Sunday will sing.

    Good to know

    Can I use Harmony?

    Not at the moment. Harmony is a private app for our own team. You can help it reach more churches with the button at the bottom of this page.

    Do I need Harmony to use PreCenter?

    No. PreCenter runs a whole service on its own. Harmony is the team’s side of the work.

    Does the phone remote need the internet?

    Pairing through your team uses the internet. Pairing by QR code works over the same Wi-Fi as the computer.

    Are the songs in the demo real?

    They are sample hymns that are in the public domain. Many modern lyrics are protected by copyright, so use songs your church has permission or a licence to use.
